question: Around when was the first meeting between Joshua and Anastasia?
answer: For the moment, when Anastasia first thought about expanding the Hoshin company to the Kingdom of Lugnica, she exchanged contact with Julius and visited their residence, so I think they probably had their first contact event at that time. It's just that, at the same time, the event of the insignia shining occurred, so he didn't make much of an impression.
